title: Minecraft Creeper
blurb: That soft ssssss is the most efficient warning in gaming: roughly one second of notice for you, and considerably less for your build. Notch created the creeper by accident — a botched pig model with the dimensions swapped — and its hiss does more psychological work than any deliberate monster design in the game. Veterans still spin on the spot two decades later, and half of them still die anyway. Aww man. Play it behind somebody concentrating hard on something fragile, or use it as the sound of a very bad idea arriving quietly from directly behind you.
origin: The creeper hiss and explosion from Minecraft (Mojang).
